tolerances.runtime_prediction: record observed semantics; no predeclared error text assumed

math.enumeration: all (A,W), Z and four independent binomial counts; invalid pW zeroed only for explicitly diagnostic kernel; preserve physical-invalid mass separately
comparisons: full four-count sum versus active-pair sum
class marginals and joint M,S moments
same Z joint likelihood versus independent response mixtures negative control
math.functionals: two equally weighted joint draws; N=(2,2), tau=nu=0.5, counts=(1,1,2,2), Z=(1,1) then (2,2); aggregate first; retain ties; margin Dobs=1 and fixed runner-up capacity=0 for explicit infeasibility flag
math.prior_checks: source-bound six Exp(5) variances, six effects, alpha+b0, precision 10000 for b0; integrate partial-order simplex density pi1^-3 using B/H,C/H coordinates

wrapper.interception: actual installed public wrapper, trace runjags::run.jags on entry and stop before sampling; preserve captured data and model
wrapper.direct_list: independent direct list compared to wrapper payload; not a test of unfrozen candidate adapter

runtime.model: byte-identical integral source; never auxiliary source
runtime.base_conditioning: N=1,a=1,w=0; all six fixed b0=0, alpha=0, variance=0.2, all six observation effects=0, pi auxiliary=(1,0.4,0.6); counts=(iota.m=0,iota.s=0,chi.m=0,chi.s=0), Z=1
runtime.conditioning_notice: nodes supplied in data are fixed/conditioned, not initial values; full graph is retained but these are not samples from the unrestricted hierarchy
runtime.mc_comparison: none; only support/phase probes, no convergence or inferential pass

decision_rules.pass: only after frozen candidate, real input closure, independent checks and all static G3 requirements satisfied
decision_rules.changes_requested: candidate implementation/evidence has a material repairable defect or overclaim
decision_rules.inconclusive: target support or unavailable comparison prevents validation without changing G2
decision_rules.preparation_only: no final gate decision, no manifest_complete for unseen candidate, no alternate candidate

candidate_v2_review_plan.MCSE: recalculate from actual chain-preserving draws for all four counts, Z indicators and each functional; equal-length four-chain formula sqrt(sum(var(batch_means)/40))/4 is algebraically correct only with valid batch variance and independent chains
candidate_v2_review_plan.MCSE_sensitivity: inspect batch-means autocorrelation and independent batch sizes 25/50/100, not a replacement or relaxation of frozen executor criterion
candidate_v2_review_plan.constant_targets: empirical zero variance alone is insufficient; verify exact support variance is zero before exempting diagnostics
candidate_v2_review_plan.diagnostics: recompute posterior rank split Rhat and bulk/tail ESS on each nonconstant monitored/derived target, not only pi or class labels
candidate_v2_review_plan.chronology: verify v1 preserved, v2 bytes and freeze precede matching seed-specific output, no live-process restart, all failed attempts retained; coordinator preflight is not user request
candidate_v2_review_plan.margin: Dobs=1 for N=1,A=0,W=0 is only an algebraic offset; fixed-runner-up physical compatibility and capacity must be flagged
